units.translation: Schol. Theocr. 4, 62: τοὺς Σατύρους [the Satyrs] (Casaubon added ἀκρατείς [unrestrained] from the lower scholium) most say, as also τοὺς Σειληνούς [the Sileni]; but Sophocles in Andromeda. It does not follow from these that καὶ Πᾶνας [the Pans too], as Aeschylus in Glaucus (fr. 29), and Sophocles themselves used the adjective κρατής [strong].
most say, as also the Sileni; but Sophocles in Andromeda.
and the Pans, as Aeschylus in Glaucus
and unmixed night holds them (thus Schuetz for ἀκραντος)
where ἀκριβῶς [accurately] is to be joined not with οἶσθα [you know], but with περισσόφρων [exceedingly wise].
or do you not know accurately, being exceedingly wise, that —
a gift of earth mixed without distinction
a shower of stones descends from the battlements throwing from above. Others understood it passively, of the battlements which are attacked with stones. Thomas Magister proposed both interpretations.
a shower of stones comes from the battlements that throw from above,
and still first-fruits of this great land.
where are my many gifts and first-fruits?
[erroneously for ἁβροπενθής [delicate in grief], which see]
to the topmost summit of the hill
to the top of the head
take courage, for the height of toil has no time.
from the depths of the heart
utterly, as we are being destroyed here.
Thus Hermann for καὶ κρυπτά γ᾽ — παλλαγμάτων [and hidden — of the dalliances].
and are these hidden dalliances of Hera?

A word of uncertain meaning, which H. Stephanus and others took as said for ἀκρωτηριασμός [mutilation], a meaning not otherwise known except that mentioned by the scholiast: κακῶν ἄθροισις ἢ λιθοβολία [a gathering of evils or stoning] (the codex has λιθοβολίας [of stoning]). Herodian says τὸ σύστημα καὶ ἄθροισμα [the organized body and gathering]. Similarly Bekker, Anecd. p. 372, 2: ἀκρωνία τὰ ἀθροίσματα. καὶ ἡ ἀκρότης καὶ ἡ ἀκμή. καὶ τὸ ἐπίλεκτον σύστημα [akronia: the gatherings; and the highest point and the prime; and the select body]. And Etym. M. p. 53, 41. And Hesychius.
a gathering of evils or stoning
Herodian says the organized body and gathering
akronia: the gatherings; and the highest point and the prime; and the select body
where M has στάσιν [standing], but the corrector wrote above γρ. βάσιν [variant: step].
